items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.

Checks discharge quantity 
 and pressure and record them.

Check the vibration level 
 of the pump set complete with the motor then, record them.

Check alignment and 
 compare it with the setting value and record it.

Make test for bearings 
 oil and added or change it ( if it is needed ).

Check flanges for water 
 leakage.

Check bolts fixation, 
 then re-righting ( if it is needed ).

Check glands for water 
 leakage and re-pack ( if it is needed ).

Check the pump casing 
 against rust and re-paint ( if it is needed ).

Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by 
M6 in above title block.
This pump is used to 
transfer condensate water from condenser hot well to dearators to feed pump of 
HRSG.
Pump Technical Specification:
Manufacture | Worthington
Model No. | 10 12KK H
Type | Multi Stage - Vertical type
Rated Capacity | 180 m3/hr
Pump discharge pressure | 12 kg/cm2
Fluid pumped | Condensate water
Design operating fluid 
 temp | 36.1 C
Speed | 1500 rpm
Bearing Type | Upper 7226 thrust & 
 Lower 6215 ball
The first draft initiated 
by Eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd Elslam, revised by 
EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda El-bana, accepted by general director eng. 
Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha 
Power Station.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.
Work 
to be carried out
Pump in 
Operation
Checks discharge quantity 
 and pressure and record them.
Check the vibration level 
 of the pump set complete with the motor then, record them.
Pump 
out of Operation
Check alignment and 
 compare it with the setting value and record it.
Make test for bearings 
 oil and added or change it ( if it is needed ).
Check flanges for water 
 leakage.
Check bolts fixation, 
 then re-righting ( if it is needed ).
Check glands for water 
 leakage and re-pack ( if it is needed ).
Check the pump casing 
 against rust and re-paint ( if it is needed ).
